sources.title: UniFi Access Point | Releases | Ubiquiti Community

articles.author: UI-Edmundas
articles.description:
Overview
This release is promoted to Official/Stable release channel for these models:


U7-Lite, U7-In-Wall, U7-Mesh, U7-Industrial, UDB-Switch, AirWire, U6-Mesh, U6-Mesh-Pro, U6-Enterprise-IW, U6-IW - November 12, 2026

U7-Pro, U7-Pro-Max, U7-Pro-Wall, U7-Pro-XG, U7-Pro-XGS, U7-Pro-XG-Wall, U7-Outdoor, U7-Pro-Outdoor, E7, E7-Campus, E7-Audience - November 18, 2026


U6 is joining the same software feature track as U7. Going forward, U6 devices will receive the same applicable software features, improvements, and fixes, while hardware-specific capabilities remain dependent on the AP model.


New Features:
U7 access points now support mesh links using 5 GHz and 6 GHz Multi-Link Operation (MLO) STR.





Added Multicast Suppression for WiFi networks.

Improvements

Added Mesh Uplink Roaming…
